text:
Laura Chen: Heads-up — we're planning to roll the audit schema changes next Wednesday. Need a short customer-facing doc with example payloads and a QA checklist. @Mike Robbins @Nisha Kapoor can you pair on samples? Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/schema-v4 (internal)
Mike Robbins: Thanks. Do we have a clear old->new field mapping? Customers will ask what broke.
Nisha Kapoor: I'll compile the top 10 events and produce before/after samples. Will include a mapping table and migration notes.
Sam Patel: FYI, product wants a one-paragraph summary highlighting backwards-compatible changes and one list of breaking changes.
Oliver Grant: Quick security note: KMS-related events are getting a new event_type `kms.key_access`. Make sure we surface `kms_key_id` but never log key material. Also track `kms.operation` (encrypt/decrypt/rotate).
Nisha Kapoor: Good call. I'll add PII redaction examples and a short snippet showing safe vs unsafe fields.
Laura Chen: Example payloads should show minimal and expanded forms. Also include an example of our new `actor.identity.source` (e.g., oauth, api-key, sso).
Mike Robbins: One more ask: include examples of webhook audit events customers can subscribe to and the recommended validation steps (HMAC header check, timestamp tolerance).
Amy Li: I'll draft the customer-facing changelog blurb and short FAQ. Can we get a small set of test vectors that customers can run against their ingestion pipelines?
Nisha Kapoor: Yes. I'll attach 8 JSON test vectors (anonymized). Sample here:
```json
{ "event_type": "resource.update", "timestamp": "2026-03-15T18:22:10Z", "actor": { "id": "user-123", "identity": { "source": "sso" } }, "resource": { "id": "model-ffd7", "type": "model", "location": "us-west-2" }, "changes": [{ "path": "/replicas", "old": 2, "new": 4 }] }
```
Oliver Grant: For KMS we recommend the following minimal schema snippet in docs:
```json
{ "event_type": "kms.key_access", "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/rdw-key-01", "operation": "decrypt", "actor": { "id": "service-account-99" } }
```
Mike Robbins: Can we also add a short section explaining audit log retention and how it ties to Dedicated / Private customers? Ops needs the wording for SLAs.
Laura Chen: Yes — Amy, please include retention and export options (S3/GCS/Syslog) and a note about delivery guarantees.
deploy-bot: staging deploy of docs/audit/schema-v4 succeeded — build #5842 — https://ci.internal/builds/5842 :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1324 — includes example payloads + migration guide. Requesting reviews from @Amy Li and @Oliver Grant.
Amy Li: I'll review tonight and add the changelog blurb. Plan to send a customer preview to 3 large accounts on Thursday.
Sam Patel: Do we need a short support playbook? Steps for CS to validate customer ingestion failures.
Nisha Kapoor: I'll add a 5-step QA checklist: 1) Compare event_type mapping 2) Validate timestamp formats (ISO8601) 3) Check required fields for each event 4) HMAC verification for webhooks 5) Verify KMS events don't include key material.
Laura Chen: Perfect. Once docs PR is green and Amy signs off, we'll schedule the customer preview email. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
